first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improved early activation and time-to-value. A guarded simplification test directly addresses the current funnel weakness while avoiding promotional pricing, which previously harmed retention. Verify both records to confirm durability and downstream revenue quality before committing.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment only for simple-workspace SMB accounts, where prior evidence shows improved activation and qualified revenue. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortening onboarding increased 60-day churn there. Monitor completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention before expanding.
